cases.name: navigate shows the route relative to the surface base
click on a role selector opens the linked route
type, press, scroll, wait and back run in order
an act on a missing element fails with qa.target.act
settle waits for a selector, artwork, a playing video and no busy element
settle on a missing selector fails with qa.target.settle
screenshot writes a PNG whose header gives the capture size
startVideo and stopVideo write a clip with a duration
logs hold page errors, console errors and 5xx responses
a missing capability rejects with qa.target.capability
trace and dump give a written path or null
ready answers a boolean and a reason when not ready
close ends the session and a second close does nothing
